# Tsir

> A backend-only TypeScript framework for Bun, Cloudflare Workers and AWS Lambda — one
> codebase, all three, inside each free tier. Pre-alpha: not published to npm.

This file is the machine-readable index. Every path below exists; `make llms` regenerates it
and `make check` fails when it is stale.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Orientation for a coding agent (or a person arriving cold) working in this repository.
- [Installation](src/docs/installation.md): Tsir is a pre-alpha TypeScript backend framework.
- [Contributing to Tsir](CONTRIBUTING.md): Thanks for helping build Tsir.
- [README](README.md): the landing page — what Tsir is for, what is real today, and the four rules a change is reviewed against

## Using the framework

- [Caching](src/docs/guides/caching.md): A cache stores the result of an expensive operation (a database query, an API call, a computed value) so the next request can…
- [Configuration and secrets](src/docs/guides/configuration.md): Tsir splits configuration into two layers, and neither one magically creates runtime clients: - tsir.js tells the CLI and deploy…
- [Controllers and HTTP routes](src/docs/guides/controllers.md): Controllers group related HTTP actions in plain classes.
- [Models, Drizzle queries and migrations](src/docs/guides/database.md): Tsir deliberately does not provide an Active Record base class.
- [Services, drivers, and defaults](src/docs/guides/drivers.md): Every capability in tsir is a port with several drivers, chosen in tsir.js by name.
- [Contributor build commands on macOS and Linux](src/docs/guides/make.md): This guide is for framework contributors building or testing the distribution.
- [Moving between Cloudflare and AWS](src/docs/guides/providers.md): Tsir separates what your app does from where it runs.
- [Jobs and queues](src/docs/guides/queues.md): A job is a unit of work that should happen outside the HTTP request/response cycle.
- [Search](src/docs/guides/search.md): Every other capability in Tsir has a real answer on both clouds.

## Reference

- [Services, drivers, and defaults](src/docs/guides/drivers.md): Every capability in tsir is a port with several drivers, chosen in tsir.js by name.
- [Error codes](src/docs/errors.md): Every TsirError code a framework package can raise.
- [Capability matrix](src/docs/capabilities.md): What runs where.
- [Compatibility policy and upgrade guide](src/docs/compatibility.md): What a version number promises, what counts as a breaking change, and how to move between versions.
- [Runtime dependencies](src/docs/dependencies.md): A runtime dependency is one an application ships.
- [Migrations & seeders runbook](src/docs/migrations.md): Everything tsir migrate, tsir migrate:status, tsir migrate:rollback, tsir migrate:verify, tsir make:migration and tsir db:seed…

- [`src/docs/error-codes.json`](src/docs/error-codes.json): every error code as data — grep this before inventing one
- [`src/docs/api-surface.json`](src/docs/api-surface.json): the exported surface of every package

## Status and plan

- [`status.json`](status.json): phase, milestone and version — the machine-readable truth the README badge reads
- [Engineering plans](plans/README.md): the internal design and sequencing record — read it when you need the reasoning behind a decision, not to use the framework
- [Task index: capabilities](plans/tasks/07-capabilities.md): every capability task and whether it has shipped — the honest backlog
- [Task index](plans/tasks/README.md): all work items, grouped by phase
